title: Quirk Skill Run Record
description: One observability event emitted while a quirk skill runs: routing, context loading, tool calls, artifacts, gates, verification, handoffs, failures, and run completion. Append-only sink: .agents/skills/platform/skill-runs/<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the Skill Run Record format.

traceId.description: UUID shared by every event of one skill run.

spanId.description: UUID of this event's span; unique inside its trace.

parentSpanId.description: UUID of the enclosing span, or null for the root event of the trace.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the event was emitted.

event.description: Lifecycle event type; the replay order is defined in replay-skill-run.mjs.

skillVersion.description: Version of the invoked skill body.

promptVersion.description: Version of the prompt or instruction set the skill ran under.

inputHash.description: sha256 of the canonicalized skill input; lets a run be replayed without storing the input.

model.description: Model that produced the run, when a model was invoked.

evidence.description: Why this event happened (routing reasons, decision notes, matched signals).

tools.description: Tool calls made during this span; never carries tool arguments or findings.

artifacts.description: Artifacts produced or read during this span, referenced by path plus content hash.

sideEffects.description: Declared side effects of the run (for example write-files); the audit vocabulary, never an execution log.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the span this event closes.

cost.description: Token and monetary cost attributed to the run so far.

verdict.description: Outcome of the run once it is decided; absent while the run is still open.

failureMode.description: Classified failure mode for failure.classified and for a terminal run that did not pass; null when there is none.
